constraints: LLM use remains optional for deterministic core functions.
Language detection is not semantic analysis.
Do not auto-delete code without future dead-code safety evidence.
GitHub Actions is CI and acceptance runner; Owner PC is not used.
Cross-platform core behavior must pass on Linux, Windows, and macOS.

entry_points.name: doctorcode scan
entry_points.purpose: Inventory a repository and recognize source languages.

entry_points.name: doctorcode toolchains
entry_points.purpose: Report compiler/runtime toolchain availability without assuming every host has every compiler.

entry_points.name: doctorcode audit
entry_points.purpose: Run registered deterministic semantic analyzers and emit normalized findings.

entry_points.name: doctorcode next
entry_points.purpose: Return the highest-priority finding as one byte-bounded evidence packet.

entry_points.name: doctorcode context
entry_points.purpose: Re-audit and return one exact finding ID as a repository-contained byte-bounded evidence packet.

entry_points.name: doctorcode benchmark
entry_points.purpose: Evaluate labeled analyzer corpora and enforce deterministic TP/FP/FN regression gates.

entry_points.name: doctorcode contract
entry_points.purpose: Freeze one exact current finding into a deterministic pre-repair verification baseline.

entry_points.name: doctorcode verify
entry_points.purpose: Re-audit a repaired repository and deterministically verify target resolution plus bounded target-path regression constraints.

entry_points.name: DoctorCode agent skill
entry_points.purpose: Guide agents through the deterministic DoctorCode audit, context, contract, repair, and verify lifecycle without duplicating core logic.

entry_points.name: doctorcode-mcp
entry_points.purpose: Run the thin local stdio MCP adapter bound to one repository root.

entry_points.name: release builder
entry_points.purpose: Build deterministic six-target DoctorCode release archives.

entry_points.name: release verifier
entry_points.purpose: Verify manifest, checksum, target, and archive contracts.

entry_points.name: Unix installer
entry_points.purpose: Install a checksum-verified native Unix release archive.

entry_points.name: Windows installer
entry_points.purpose: Install a checksum-verified native Windows release archive.

expected_outcomes: high-signal machine-readable findings instead of whole-repository prompts
conservative evidence for deleting unused or stale code
deterministic verification before findings are called resolved
project.name: DoctorCode
project.purpose: Deterministically reduce large codebases into small evidence-backed findings for bloat, security, simplification, logic, and dead/stale code so humans and small LLMs can review and repair code with low token usage.
